scope_note: This is NOT independent replication. The cohort used here (ov_tcga / ov_tcga_pub, n=303) is the SAME TCGA ovarian patient set as W1 (ov_tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018, n=299), reprocessed by a different cBioPortal pipeline. It demonstrates the prognostic null is stable to reprocessing/normalization, not that it replicates in an external cohort.

same_cohort_reprocessing.relationship_to_w1: same TCGA-OV patients, different cBioPortal pipeline
